name: Arrowlake ITX
desc: The Invendis ARL Mini ITX is a high-performance industrial computing platform powered by Intel Core Ultra Processors (Series 2) with integrated NPU AI acceleration, Intel Arc 140T graphics, and up to 128 GB DDR5 RAM. Housed in an aluminium heatsink enclosure with fanless or fan options, it offers dual 2.5 GbE LAN ports, triple display outputs (2× HDMI, 1× DP), and extensive M.2 expansion for Wi-Fi 6, 4G/5G cellular, and NVMe storage.
cpu: Intel Core Ultra (Series 2) — Ultra 5 & Ultra 7, 14/16 Cores, 5.1 GHz Turbo (CPU + GPU + NPU)
storage: 1× M.2 (B Key, 2280) PCIe ×4 NVMe; 2× SATA3 (6 Gb/s)
housing: Aluminium Heat Sink with CRCA Enclosure

additional_specs.v: Intel Arc 140T GPU; PCIe Gen 5 ×8 discrete GPU support (Optional)
